q: ____ is an encyclopaedia? — It is a book about many subjects.
explain: 询问事物用 What

q: ____ writes the articles in an encyclopaedia? — Experts.
explain: 询问人用 Who

q: ____ can we find the word list? — In the index.
explain: 询问地点用 Where

q: ____ was the first encyclopaedia published? — About 2,000 years ago.
explain: 询问时间用 When

q: ____ do students read encyclopaedias? — Because they want quick information.
explain: 用 Why 提问，答语用 Because

q: ____ do you search for a topic? — Look up the key word in the index.
explain: 询问方式方法用 How

q: ____ books are there on the shelf? — Twenty.
explain: 可数名词数量用 How many

q: ____ encyclopaedia is this, yours or mine?
explain: 询问所属用 Whose

q: ____ is the encyclopaedia? — It's on the shelf.
explain: 问位置用 Where

q: ____ is the book about? — It's about animals.
explain: 问内容用 What ... about

q: 1,000,000 in English is ____.
explain: 1,000,000 = one million
1,000,000,000 = one billion

q: 386 is read as ____.
explain: 英式英语 hundred 后加 and：three hundred and eighty-six

q: After a number, the word 'hundred' takes ____.
explain: 具体数字后 hundred 不加 s：two hundred

q: With 'of', we say ____.
explain: 与 of 连用要加 s：thousands of people
10,000 = ten thousand
2,500 = two thousand five hundred

q: There are ____ students. (100)
explain: 100 = a hundred / one hundred

q: In British English, 306 = three hundred ____ six.
explain: hundred 后加 and：three hundred and six

q: one point four million = ____.
explain: one point four million = 1.4 百万 = 1,400,000

q: ____ on the computer. (开机)
explain: 祈使句用动词原形 Turn

q: ____ your password.
explain: 祈使句动词原形开头 Type

q: To tell someone NOT to do something, use ____.
explain: 否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形

q: ____ share your password with others.
explain: 否定祈使句用 Don't

q: To be polite, add ____ before the instruction.
explain: 礼貌用 please

q: Steps often follow: first, then, next, ____.
explain: 步骤顺序：first / then / next / finally

q: ____ the file before you close it.
explain: 祈使句用动词原形 Save

q: An imperative (instruction) sentence usually has ____.
explain: 祈使句省略主语，动词原形开头

q: ____ the mouse to open the file.
explain: 祈使句用动词原形 Click

q: Please ____ here.
explain: please 后接动词原形 click

q: Paper ____ by the Chinese.
explain: 被动语态 was + 过去分词 invented

q: The light bulb ____ by Edison.
explain: 过去被动 was invented

q: Passive voice is formed with ____ + past participle.
explain: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词

q: 'by' in passive voice shows ____.
explain: by 引出动作的执行者

q: The books ____ by machines now.
explain: 现在被动 are + 过去分词 printed

q: When was the compass invented? — It ____ more than 2,000 years ago.
explain: 过去被动 was invented

q: The new computer ____ next year.
explain: 将来被动 will be + 过去分词

q: Active: People protect pandas. Passive: Pandas ____ by people.
explain: 被动 are + 过去分词 protected

q: We can omit 'by ...' when ____.
options: the doer is unknown or not important
explain: 动作执行者未知或不重要时省略 by

q: The letter ____ by hand.
explain: 被动 is + 过去分词 written

q: I am ____ tired after the long trip.
explain: very 修饰形容词表程度强

q: The homework is ____ difficult — I can't finish it.
explain: too 表示“太过”

q: I am old ____ to read this book.
explain: enough 放形容词后：old enough

q: ____ goes AFTER the adjective: 'old enough', not 'enough old'.
explain: enough 修饰形容词时后置

q: Please speak ____ louder.
explain: a little 表“一点点”修饰比较级

q: This book is ____ interesting.
explain: really 表程度强

q: 'too' means ____.
explain: too 表示“超过所需”

q: Her memory is ____ good.
explain: quite 表“相当”

q: She runs ____ fast.
explain: very 修饰副词 fast

q: I am ____ tired today.
explain: a bit 表“有点”

q: When the soldiers arrived, the Emperor ____ already left.
explain: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词

q: Past perfect is formed with ____ + past participle.
explain: 过去完成时 = had + 过去分词

q: By the time we got there, the film ____.
explain: 过去某动作之前已发生，用过去完成时 had started

q: She ____ never seen the sea before she was ten.
explain: 过去完成时 had never seen

q: I got home at 7. I ____ my homework at 6.
explain: 先发生用过去完成时 had finished

q: Which word often goes with the past perfect?
explain: before / after / by the time 常与过去完成时连用

q: ____ you met him before that day?
explain: 过去完成时疑问句用 Had

q: They ____ read the story before the teacher told it.
explain: 过去完成时否定 hadn't read

q: The past perfect shows an action that happened ____ another past action.
explain: 过去完成时表“过去的过去”

q: By 2010 he ____ three books.
explain: by + 过去时间点，用过去完成时 had written

q: Winter in Harbin is ____ than in Guangzhou.
explain: 两者比较用比较级 colder + than

q: Harbin has the ____ winter in China.
explain: 三者以上用最高级 the coldest

q: good → ____ → the best.
explain: good 的比较级是 better（不规则）

q: Typhoons are ____ than summer rain.
explain: 多音节形容词比较级用 more + 形容词

q: This is the ____ interesting season of the year.
explain: 多音节最高级用 the most

q: bad → ____ → the worst.
explain: bad 的比较级是 worse（不规则）

q: Guangzhou is ____ Shanghai in size. (一样大)
explain: 同级比较用 as + 形容词 + as

q: Today is ____ yesterday. (不如…热)
explain: 否定同级比较 not as + 形容词 + as

q: The colder, ____ better.
explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级“越…越…”

q: August is the ____ month here.
explain: 最高级 the hottest（重读闭音节双写 t）

q: Direct: He says, “I am nervous.” Reported: He says that he ____ nervous.
explain: 主句 says 是现在时，从句时态不变 is

q: Direct: She said, “I am tired.” Reported: She said that she ____ tired.
explain: 主句过去时，从句退一步用 was

q: Direct: “I will help you,” he said. Reported: He said he ____ help me.
explain: will 在间接引语中变 would

q: Direct: “I have won,” she said. Reported: She said she ____ won.
explain: 现在完成时变为过去完成时 had won

q: Reported questions use ____ word order.
explain: 间接问句用陈述语序

q: Direct: “Where is the stage?” Reported: He asked where the stage ____.
explain: 间接引语时态后移，用 was 并用陈述语序

q: Direct: “Do you like English?” Reported: She asked ____ I liked English.
explain: 一般疑问句变间接引语用 if / whether

q: In reported speech, 'today' changes to ____.
explain: today → that day

q: 'tomorrow' changes to ____.
explain: tomorrow → the next day

q: 'here' changes to ____.
explain: here → there
